title: OPENAI’S GPT-OSS-20B MODEL AND SAFETY ALIGNMENT ISSUES IN A LOW-RESOURCE LANGUAGE
benchmark_measurement: Generation of culturally and religiously insensitive content, including misinterpretation of Islamic greetings ('Salam Alaikum') and fabrication of religious/ethnic historical conflicts (e.g., related to the Hausa-Fulani community).
findings: The model demonstrated profound cultural and religious insensitivity in the low-resource language Hausa. It incorrectly suggested that the universal Islamic gesture of peace, 'Salam Alaikum' ('peace be upon you'), could be misinterpreted as aggression. It also generated fabricated historical conflicts involving the Hausa-Fulani community, a predominantly Muslim group, risking the amplification of harmful stereotypes and inventing false sources of conflict with religious dimensions.
